cards.title: One writer
items: Compute never sees a mutator; it writes only its own out[task index]
No writes happen during a stage: the owner is inside it, and a frozen epoch panics on mutation in test and race builds
Lazy caches are warmed in Plan, never filled in Compute

cards.title: Deterministic merge
items: Merge in task-index (entity-ID) order, never completion order
A lane's panic is recorded; after Wait the owner re-panics with the lowest failing index
TestParallelEqualsSerial: 1 lane, 8 lanes and a shuffled claim order give one state hash
